Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.label: passive darkness event
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.description: The passive darkness event is a quieter one. The darkness does not hunt you on purpose, only if you come close. They are also slower.
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.letterText: A strange but calm darkness can be seen in the distance, slowly approaching your settlement.

Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.label: approaching darkness event
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.description: The approaching darkness event is a normal event, except that you see the darkness on the horizon coming sooner, which gives you more time to prepare.
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.letterText: A strange darkness can be seen on the horizon, approaching the settlement quite quickly. You had better prepare.

Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.label: ordinary darkness event
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.description: An ordinary darkness event is a normal event. You have only 60 seconds to prepare. The darkness will hunt down your colonists and break your doors.
Darkest_SK.DarknessEventDef.letterText: The lord of darkness has come for your souls... prepare for the darkness and the dreadful cold!\n\nStay near the light. Only it will save you.
